plainTranslation: A's depth and power meets B's structure. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control sit right on top of your commitments, limits, and self-discipline.
summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control sit right on top of your commitments, limits, and self-discipline. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
